summary: Independent review reproduced the silent transformer-layout weight drop on the prepared base through the production Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration.load_weights implementation. At exact candidate commit 7583e07e47654363c9fbf93eb0ed65f2c891110e, the candidate regression and adjacent GLM tests passed, and independent GPU checks verified exact source-to-destination values and shapes for all four reported families: mHC, KDA forget-gate, packed routed MoE gate/up/down, and packed KDA q/k/v conv1d. Malformed packed tensors fail explicitly. No counterexample to the reported loader contract was found.
